name: blog-audio
description: > Paid Gemini TTS audio for a finished blog post: summary, full read-aloud, or two-speaker dialogue, with an MP3 and an HTML5 embed. Asks for explicit consent before the first paid call. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog audio, "generate audio for this blog post", "narrate this blog post", "audio version of this post", or "podcast version of this post". Not for general speech or dictation questions.
author: AgriciDaniel
